description: FIM exclusion rules. Every hit is recorded in audit.log; rules match the POSIX-style path relative to the watch root (or a path suffix / basename).

rules.description: Temporary files and directories: editor swap/backup files, atomic-write temp files, /tmp-style scratch dirs.
Build outputs and generated artifacts: __pycache__/*.pyc, .pyo, dist/, build/, *.egg-info.
Application logs and logrotate-style rotated files (app.log, app.log.1, app.log.2026-09-28.gz, app.err).
